_comment: Laya's on-device files (docs/BUILD.md A1, risk 2). The download host is EMPTY until the owner sets it: the app then says 'Model host not configured' and downloads nothing. urlTemplate placeholders: {host} (https only), {variant}, {file}. Sizes and SHA-256s are the exports parity was measured on; a re-export changes them together with the Kotlin pins in LayaModelStore (a test checks the two agree).
